messages.text: I'm sorry, but I can't refund the bath mat. Our records show the shop received it back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund request came too late, though. The order was delivered on 2026-09-21, so the deadline was 2026-10-21 17:21 UTC. A refund must be requested within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window), and the policy has no exceptions to that limit.
